top.title: Eviden lance SMX, son nouveau loch électromagnétique destiné aux drones de surface et aux drones sous-marins
top.summary: Eviden, a division of Atos Group, has launched SMX, a compact electromagnetic log designed for autonomous naval platforms including surface and underwater drones. The device provides precise water speed measurements for navigation and autopilot capabilities, is manufactured in France with MIL-STD qualification, and emits no acoustic signals, making it suitable for military and civilian maritime applications.

top.title: Eviden launches SMX, its new electromagnetic speed log for surface and underwater drones
top.summary: Eviden, the Atos Group product brand, has launched SMX, a new electromagnetic speed log designed for uncrewed surface and underwater vehicles. The compact sensor, rated to 300 meters depth, measures speed through water with high accuracy to support autonomous naval operations. SMX is designed and manufactured in France at Eviden's facility in Aix-en-Provence and features no acoustic emissions, making it suitable for both military and civilian oceanographic applications.

top.title: Financial abuse may be more common and less understood than many Canadians realize, new research suggests
top.summary: New research commissioned by The Allstate Foundation of Canada reveals a significant awareness gap regarding financial abuse as a form of domestic abuse in Canada. While only 9% of respondents identified financial abuse when asked to define domestic abuse, 56% recognized financially abusive behaviours when presented with specific examples. The study found that 75% of respondents reported personal experience with or knowledge of domestic abuse, and over three-quarters identified financial barriers as obstacles to seeking safety. The Foundation emphasizes the importance of awareness-building, research, and partnerships with community organizations to help survivors regain financial independence.

The lawsuit claims the company failed to disclose that its conversion funnel was slowing and that its $1 billion monthly funded volume target was likely to be deferred. top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Better Home & Finance Holding Company (NASDAQ: BETR) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Webull Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Webull Corporation alleging that the company made false and misleading statements about its operations. The complaint claims Webull misrepresented its independence from China, stating that its software development, data pipelines, and core engineering actually depend on PRC-based personnel and infrastructure, contrary to claims that principal operations were U.S.-based. Investors who purchased Webull securities between April 26, 2025 and October 6, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 7, 2026.

top.title: Lead Plaintiff Deadlines in Shareholder Class Action Lawsuits Against The Ensign Group, Inc. (ENSG), Netcapital Inc. (NCPL), and Webull Corporation (BULL) Announced by Holzer & Holzer, LLC
top.summary: Holzer & Holzer, LLC announced lead plaintiff deadlines (December 7, 2026) for multiple shareholder class action lawsuits. The Ensign Group faces allegations of fraudulent billing practices (Feb 2022-June 2026), Netcapital faces revenue recognition fraud claims (Dec 2021-Sept 2026), and Webull faces allegations regarding undisclosed China ties (April 2025-Oct 2026). Investors who purchased shares during these periods and suffered losses are encouraged to seek legal representation.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Celsius Holdings, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Celsius Holdings, Inc. alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding health risks associated with Alani Nu products, including inadequate disclosure of cardiac risks and improper marketing to minors. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased Celsius securities between February 21, 2025 and June 3, 2026.

top.title: Celsius Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CELH) SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in Celsius Holdings, Inc. Securities Lawsuit - Contact Portnoy Law Firm
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Celsius Holdings (CELH) for allegedly misleading investors about the safety of Alani Nu energy drinks acquired in April 2025. The complaint alleges the company failed to disclose cardiac risks from high caffeine content (200mg per 12oz serving) and actively marketed these drinks to minors despite claiming otherwise. Stock declined 4.18% on April 10, 2026 following a wrongful death lawsuit report, and 7.53% on June 4, 2026 after a Texas investigation announcement.

top.title: Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:DNB) SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Inc. Securities Lawsuit - Contact Portnoy Law Firm
top.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Celsius Holdings, and Ryde Group on behalf of shareholders who suffered losses. The D&B lawsuit alleges that executives misrepresented a merger with Clearlake Capital Group at $9.15 per share, which was significantly below alternative valuations and concealed the true motivations behind the transaction. Investors have until November 10, 2026 to seek appointment as lead plaintiff.

top.title: Christian Dior : Assemblée Générale Mixte du 2 novembre 2026 : transformation en société anonyme
top.summary: Christian Dior held a Mixed General Assembly on November 2, 2026, where shareholders approved the company's change of legal form from a European company to an anonymous society (société anonyme). This simplification was part of a broader restructuring project studied by the Arnault family group. The company also reported continued growth in Q3 2026 with €57.1 billion in revenue for the first nine months and made changes to its Board of Directors composition.

top.title: Christian Dior : Combined Shareholders’ Meeting held on November 2nd, 2026 : transformation into a public limited liability company
top.summary: Christian Dior held a Combined Shareholders' Meeting on November 2nd, 2026, where shareholders approved the transformation of the company's legal form from a European company (société européenne) to a public limited liability company (société anonyme). The company also reported continued growth in Q3 2026 with revenue of €57.1 billion in the first nine months and organic revenue growth of 2%. Additionally, the Board of Directors co-opted two independent directors.

top.title: DICK’s Sporting Goods, Inc. (NYSE: DKS) SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in DICK’s Sporting Goods, Inc. Securities Lawsuit - Contact Portnoy Law Firm
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against DICK's Sporting Goods for allegedly making false statements about its $2.5 billion Foot Locker acquisition. The lawsuit claims the company misrepresented the success of inventory cleanup efforts and failed to disclose Foot Locker's vulnerability to industry-wide promotional pressures. Following disappointing Q2 2026 results and reduced guidance, DKS stock fell approximately 30% on August 25, 2026.

top.title: Deadline Alert: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. Investors Have Until November 3, 2026 to Seek Lead Plaintiff Role in Securities Fraud Class Action, Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP Reminds Investors
top.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit covering investors who purchased securities between September 8, 2025 and August 24, 2026. The complaint alleges the company failed to disclose that Foot Locker's inventory cleanup was incomplete and remained burdened with stagnant legacy footwear vulnerable to industry-wide promotional pressure. The stock fell 30.68% on August 25, 2026 after the company reported disappointing Q2 results and lowered full-year guidance.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges DICK’S Sporting Goods, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding its financial prospects following the Foot Locker acquisition. The complaint claims that stagnant inventory issues at Foot Locker adversely affected the company's ability to meet sales and profitability targets, which defendants failed to disclose to investors during the class period from September 8, 2025 to August 24, 2026.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. top.title: FuelCell Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ:FCEL) SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in FuelCell Energy, Inc. Securities Lawsuit - Contact Portnoy Law Firm
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against FuelCell Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCEL) alleging that company leadership concealed critical operational shortcomings regarding manufacturing capacity to fulfill a major 380 MW capital equipment purchase agreement with Fit Energy USA LP announced on June 24, 2026. The complaint claims FuelCell lacked adequate production capacity, resulting in manufacturing costs exceeding contractual prices and millions in undisclosed losses. The company reported a $45.3 million net loss and $17 million in Phase 0 charges on September 2, 2026, causing the stock to drop 15.69%. Investors who purchased shares between June 24 and September 1, 2026 may seek to join the class action with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 10, 2026.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +1.5 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +1.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: FLNC Investor Alert: Fluence Energy, Inc. Securities Class Action Notice - Contact SueWallSt
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Fluence Energy (NASDAQ: FLNC) alleging the company misrepresented the effectiveness of corrective measures to fix contract manufacturing problems. The lawsuit covers the period from November 24, 2025 through September 16, 2026, during which FLNC shares declined significantly and fiscal 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance swung from a $50 million midpoint to a $200 million loss. The complaint claims production issues at an Arizona facility spread to new international and U.S. facilities, contradicting management's assertions that remediation efforts were working.

top.title: Fluence Energy, Inc. (FLNC) Investors: November 3, 2026, Filing Deadline in Securities Fraud Class Action - Contact Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP
top.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Fluence Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNC) for allegedly making material misstatements about its ability to meet financial guidance. The company failed to disclose production problems at contract manufacturing facilities and cut its fiscal 2026 revenue guidance by approximately $600 million to $2.4 billion on September 16, 2026, causing the stock to fall 15.36%. Investors have until November 27, 2026, to file for lead plaintiff status.

top.title: FLNC ALERT: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds Fluence Energy, Inc. Investors to Contact the Firm Regarding Their Rights Before November 30th
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Fluence Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNC) alleging that the company and its executives made false and misleading statements regarding their ability to deliver backlog and meet fiscal 2026 guidance. The complaint claims the company failed to disclose production problems at contract manufacturing facilities and that corrective measures were ineffective. top.title: Geely E2 (EX2) Reaches One Million Global Sales in just 2 years
top.summary: Geely Auto announced that its E2 (EX2) model has achieved one million cumulative global sales just two years after its October 2024 launch, averaging one vehicle sold per minute. The model became the world's best-selling car in A&B segments in 2025 with 465,775 units sold and has expanded to over 30 markets globally. The vehicle's success is attributed to its safety features, practical design, and intelligent technology, including dual five-star Euro NCAP and ANCAP safety ratings achieved in September 2026.

top.title: Software-Defined Vehicle OTA Updates to Surpass 2 Billion Annually by 2035 as Automakers Shift to Monetizable Software Platforms
top.summary: Annual OTA update volumes for software-defined vehicles are forecast to reach 2.03 billion globally by 2035, up from 546.1 million in 2025. Level 3+ SDVs are expected to rise from 16% of global vehicle shipments in 2025 to 46% by 2035, with Asia-Pacific dominating at 63% market share. Chinese automakers including BYD, Tesla, and others are leading the fragmented SDV market, with success dependent on centralized compute, OTA capabilities, and scalable electrical/electronic architectures.

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+15.9% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (90) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（90）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

top.title: Cogent Security Makes the Fortune Cyber 60 for a Second Year, With a Plan to Run Cyber Defense Like a Factory
top.summary: Cogent Security, an applied AI cybersecurity company, has been named to the Fortune Cyber 60 list for the second consecutive year. The company addresses the gap between attacker speed and enterprise defense response by introducing the Cyber Defense Factory operating model, which uses AI agents to automate vulnerability management and remediation at scale. During the PHP2Shell vulnerability incident, Cogent's system identified critical assets in five minutes and reduced exposure windows by 97% for Fortune 500 customers.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Alphabet Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Alphabet Inc. alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding Gemini 3.5 Pro's performance. The complaint claims the AI model delivered disappointing training results, leading to significant launch delays, and that management's positive statements about the company's business and prospects lacked a reasonable basis. Investors who purchased Alphabet securities between May 19, 2026 and July 16, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 1, 2026.

top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Triller Group Inc. (ILLR) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims Triller made false statements regarding its control of BKFC, failed to timely file financial reports due to accounting issues, faced delisting risk from NASDAQ, and overstated its ability to resolve non-compliance issues. Investors who purchased securities between October 16, 2024 and December 29, 2025 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 14, 2026.

top.summary: Kentucky First Federal Bancorp (KFFB) reported net income of $919,000 ($0.11 diluted EPS) for Q3 2026, up 167% from $344,000 ($0.04 EPS) in Q3 2025. The improvement was driven by higher net interest income (+25.5% to $3.1M), lower non-interest expenses, and increased loan rates, partially offset by a $40,000 provision for credit losses and higher tax expenses. Total assets decreased slightly to $356.3M, while shareholders' equity grew to $51.0M.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Alerts Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) Investors to a Securities Class Action Lawsuit – Contact the Firm Before Deadline on December 8, 2026 for Leadership Role
top.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Millrose made false statements in its spin-off prospectus, claiming it would not enter into lease agreements or have tenants, when in fact the company purchased $200 million in finished homes from parent company Lennar with intent to lease them on the rental market. The revelation caused Millrose shares to fall 8.5% on October 5, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 8, 2026.

top.title: Lincoln Educational Services Corp. (NASDAQ:LINC) SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in Lincoln Educational Services Corp. Securities Lawsuit - Contact Portnoy Law Firm
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Lincoln Educational Services Corp. (NASDAQ: LINC) for allegedly issuing false and misleading statements regarding student enrollment and conversion rates. The company's admissions process failed to effectively convert enrolled students into actual student starts, causing a significant decline in student starts relative to enrollment figures. Lincoln's stock dropped $10.22 per share (24.93%) on August 10, 2026, following the disclosure of these operational issues. Investors who purchased LINC stock between May 11, 2026 and August 9, 2026 may seek to recover losses by November 10, 2026.

top.summary: A SEON survey of 2,026 U.S. adults reveals a significant trust gap with AI agents. The findings highlight the need for robust fraud detection and identity verification as AI agents move toward handling sensitive financial operations.

The transaction, expected to close in mid-2027, includes CDMO operations at sites in California, Wisconsin, Missouri, and Indiana. The deal allows Merck KGaA to focus on innovation-driven businesses while providing Lonza with expanded US manufacturing capacity and capabilities.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Alerts Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) Investors to a Securities Class Action Lawsuit – Contact the Firm Before Deadline on December 8, 2026 for Leadership Role
top.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Millrose made false statements in its spin-off prospectus, claiming it would not enter into lease agreements or have tenants, when in fact the company purchased $200 million in finished homes from parent company Lennar with intent to lease them on the rental market. The revelation caused Millrose shares to fall 8.5% on October 5, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 8, 2026.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Millrose Properties, Inc. (NYSE: MRP) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company failed to disclose that it would purchase $200 million in properties from Lennar Corporation and lease them at a loss, contrary to its stated business objectives. Investors who purchased MRP securities between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 8, 2026.

Investors who purchased shares during these periods and suffered losses are encouraged to seek legal representation.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against O-I Glass, Inc. (NYSE: OI) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against O-I Glass, Inc. (NYSE: OI) alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its Fit to Win cost-saving program. The complaint claims the company experienced delays in achieving targeted savings, faced higher-than-expected expenses and operational disruptions, and dealt with competitive and energy-cost pressures in European operations. Investors who purchased OI securities between March 14, 2025 and July 28, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 28, 2026.

top.title: FarmQA and Planet Collaborate to Bring AI-Powered Yield Intelligence to Enterprise Agriculture
top.summary: FarmQA and Planet Labs PBC have announced a strategic collaboration to develop AI-powered agronomic intelligence tools for enterprise agriculture. The partnership combines Planet's daily satellite imagery with FarmQA's structured agronomic field data to create an AI-driven sugar beet yield estimation model currently being piloted with multiple sugar beet cooperatives during the 2026 growing season. The tool aims to replace manual sampling and spreadsheet-based forecasting with digital yield estimates throughout the growing season.

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +3.7 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +3.7 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: QFIN Investor Alert: Qfin Holdings, Inc. Securities Class Action Notice - Contact SueWallSt
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Qfin Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: QFIN) alleging the company failed to disclose how tightening PRC lending and collection regulations were materially impacting earnings, despite promoting a compliance-first strategy. The stock fell 18.91% on August 26, 2026, following guidance of a 67-73% year-over-year decline in Q3 non-GAAP net income. The lawsuit covers purchases between March 18, 2026 and August 25, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 27, 2026.

top.title: PZZA DEADLINE ALERT: ROSEN, NATIONAL TRIAL LAWYERS, Encourages Papa John’s International, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 2 Deadline in Securities Class Action - PZZA
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces securities class action lawsuits against Papa John's International, Everest Group, and Qfin Holdings. The Papa John's lawsuit alleges the company made false statements about its transformation strategy and concealed market share losses. Investors who purchased shares during specified class periods are encouraged to secure counsel before November 2, 2026 deadline.

top.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Everest Group, Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EG
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Everest Group, Papa John's International, and Qfin Holdings on behalf of investors who purchased common stock during specified periods. The lawsuit against Everest Group alleges the company made false statements regarding casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves that overstated earnings. Investors are encouraged to secure counsel before upcoming deadlines.

top.title: QFIN DEADLINE: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Qfin Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - QFIN
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors who purchased Qfin Holdings securities between March 18, 2026 and August 25, 2026 of the November 30, 2026 deadline to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Qfin made false and misleading statements about the resiliency of its business and downplayed the negative impact of regulatory headwinds on its financial results.

top.title: Radiopharm Theranostics Reports Business Update
top.summary: Radiopharm Theranostics announced successful completion of an End-of-Phase 2 meeting with the FDA for RAD101, a brain metastases imaging agent that demonstrated 93% concordance with MRI. The company is preparing to initiate a pivotal Phase 3 trial in 1Q27 and has secured a manufacturing partnership with Siemens Healthineers. Additionally, Radiopharm reported positive Phase 1 imaging data for RAD301 in pancreatic cancer and advanced RAD202 to the fourth dosing cohort in its HER2+ solid tumor study.

top.title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Market in India: USD 452.9 Million Opportunity by 2032 as Digital Diabetes Care Expands, Reports Mordor Intelligence
top.summary: India's continuous glucose monitoring market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 11.90% from 2027-2032, reaching USD 452.9 million by 2032. The market expansion is driven by growing adoption of sensor-based monitoring, digital healthcare integration, and expanding diabetes management programs. However, high device costs and limited reimbursement coverage remain barriers to wider adoption.

top.title: BTK Inhibitors Market to Expand During the Forecast Period (2026–2036) as Targeted Treatments Advance Across B-Cell Malignancies and Autoimmune Disorders | DelveInsight
top.summary: The BTK inhibitors market is expected to experience steady growth through 2036, driven by increasing prevalence of B-cell malignancies, established clinical benefits, and an expanding pipeline of next-generation therapies. Key developments include FDA approvals for new indications and multiple drugs in clinical trials targeting oncology and autoimmune diseases across the 7MM markets.

top.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Celsius Holdings, and Ryde Group on behalf of shareholders who suffered losses. top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Ryde Group Ltd Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Ryde Group Ltd alleging securities fraud violations. The complaint claims the company was subject to a fraudulent stock promotion scheme involving social media misinformation, impersonated financial professionals, and coordinated share dumping by insiders using offshore accounts. Investors who purchased Ryde securities between March 6, 2024 and September 11, 2024 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 9, 2026.

top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Tigo Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: TYGO) alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding revenue projections tied to its EG4 partnership. top.summary: Upwork Inc. announced the public beta of Upwork Now, an on-demand hiring platform enabling clients to find and hire skilled freelancers in minutes. Early testing showed typical hiring times under 30 minutes with freelancer response times around 5 minutes.

top.title: UroGen Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 1 Trial of UGN-501, an Investigational Next-Generation Oncolytic Virus for Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer
top.summary: UroGen Pharma announced the first patient dosing in a Phase 1 clinical trial of UGN-501, an investigational next-generation oncolytic virus designed to treat non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). The open-label, dose-escalation trial will evaluate safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of intravesical administration in patients with recurrent NMIBC. The company is also conducting parallel nonclinical studies exploring UGN-501 formulation with its proprietary RTGel technology.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+0.6 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+0.6 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。
